title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 26: the word against Tyre, the army brought against her walls, and the city made a bare rock in the sea.

questions.text: What had Tyre said about Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Tyre said against Jerusalem: Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me.

questions.text: What were the many nations coming up against Tyre compared to?
questions.explanation: He says he will cause many nations to come up against Tyre, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

answers.text: To a flock of birds in the sky
To a fire burning in the forest
To the waves of the sea coming up
To a cloud covering the mountains

questions.text: What would Tyre be made after her dust was scraped from her?
questions.explanation: He says they will destroy her walls and break down her towers, and that he will scrape her dust from her and make her a bare rock.

questions.text: What does the chapter say Tyre will be a place for?
questions.explanation: It says she will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea, and will become plunder for the nations.

questions.text: Whom would the Lord Yahweh bring on Tyre from the north?
questions.explanation: He says he will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, chariots, horsemen and a great army.

questions.text: With what would Tyre's towers be broken down?
questions.explanation: The chapter says he will set his battering engines against her walls, and with his axes he will break down her towers.

questions.text: Where would Tyre's stones, timber and dust be laid?
questions.explanation: It says they will break down her walls and destroy her pleasant houses, and will lay her stones, her timber and her dust in the middle of the waters.

answers.text: On the mountains of the north
In the middle of the waters

questions.text: Which sound does the chapter say will not be heard any more in Tyre?
questions.explanation: He says he will cause the noise of her songs to cease, and the sound of her harps will not be heard any more.

questions.text: What would the princes of the sea do when Tyre fell?
questions.explanation: The chapter says all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, lay aside their robes, clothe themselves with trembling and sit on the ground.

answers.text: Send her gifts of gold and silver
Sail to her harbour with ships
Come down from their thrones and sit on the ground
Build her walls again with cedar

questions.text: What does the last verse say about those who look for Tyre?
questions.explanation: It says he will make her a terror and she will no more have any being; though she is sought for, she will never be found again.

answers.text: They will find her after many years
They will never find her again
They will find only her towers
They will buy her stones for a price
